The bike cellar in building C closes for renovation from Monday 4 May to Friday 22 May, and all bikes, without exception, must be out by Sunday 3 May, 18:00. Temporary racks for 40 bikes stand behind the canteen. Any bike still in the cellar after the deadline will be moved to the depot at Ostring 12, where it can be collected with a staff badge. Questions go to the facility desk, extension 4410.
